name: Deepworks winch, pulley and inner bar
notes: The wiring of the Deepworks blockout (scene deepworks, mw-e26.2). The winch lever inside the winch house and the shootable winch pulley over the cage bay both call the cage down: a latch keeps it down and opens the cage lift's gate (cage-gate, onto the shaft to the silver level) and the cage bay's gate (cage-bay-gate, the winch-cage way in from the forecourt). The inner-bar lever, which a sorcerer can pull from range through the slit, raises the inner-bar portcullis. Binding names are the scene's spawn ids.
